newsitem.title: CYPRUS: SOCCER-CYPRUS NAME SQUAD FOR ISRAEL WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CYPRUS NAME SQUAD FOR ISRAEL WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Cyprus have named an 18-man squad for Sunday's World Cup qualifier against Israel in Limassol.
Cyprus lost their opening group 5 match 4-0 to leaders Russia. Israel are in second place on goal difference.
Defenders: George Theodotou, Demetris Ioannou, Costas Panayi, Nicos Timotheou, Pambos Pittas, George Christodoulou.
Midfielders: Pambis Andreou, Sakis Andreou, Marios Christodoulou, Neophytos Larkou.
Forwards: Klimis Alexandrou, Marios Agathocleous, Sinica Gogic, Costas Malekkos, Yiotis Engomitis, Yiannos Ioannou.
